svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Work item resolution
svg.desc: The osf CLI resolves a pull request's work item from its body, fetches the issue through the code host API, and saves it for the reviewer jobs. The changed functions are `own_issue`, `named_issue`, `find` and `check_binding`.

g.text: CODE HOST API · GH API, READ-ONLY TOKEN
REVIEW RUN · BUILD AND REVIEWER JOBS
